definitions.explanation: Currency used for transactions. The everyday word for money.

notes:
{金|かね} is the everyday, somewhat casual word for money.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {金|かね}がある/ない (to have/not have money)
- {金|かね}を{使|つか}う (to spend money)
- {金|かね}を{貯|た}める (to save money)
- {金|かね}を{払|はら}う (to pay money)
- {金|かね}を{借|か}りる (to borrow money)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- お{金|かね} (money - polite form)
- {金持|かねも}ち (rich person)
- {金|かね}づかい (spending habits)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {金|かね}/お{金|かね}: money (everyday)
- {現金|げんきん}: cash (as opposed to card)
- {資金|しきん}: funds, capital (business)

NOTE: お{金|かね} with the お prefix is more polite and commonly used.
